entities.summary: Yasnier Toledo López is a Cuban amateur boxer from Pinar del Río who won the bronze medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics and the PanAm lightweight title in 2011. He is a southpaw. Yasniel Toledo was a athletes & competitors from Pinar del Río (b. 1989-09-15, Pinar del Río). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
